dataNote: Synthetic or user-entered data only. No client or engagement data.

inputs.finding: Approver can view other teams’ invoices by changing an ID

decisions.statement: Owner: Sample owner. Overrode the HUMAN verdict: Low confidence and parent scope: keep a person in the loop

assumptions: Agents are rated on repeatability, verifiability and breadth. People are rated on context, chaining and novelty.
"Unsure" counts as half a yes and lowers confidence by 5.
Anything touching the parent’s systems, the parent’s IP or production data keeps a person involved.
limits: The scores are ApexVector defaults chosen to make the reasoning visible. They are not measured agent or human performance.
The classifier works from the class and the flags only. It has not seen the finding itself.
Agent capability changes quickly. Re-check the base scores each quarter.
A verdict is advice on who should hunt for a class of finding. It does not say whether a finding exists or how severe it is.
